Describe the specific user problem and how this change improves safe access to NYC public services.

## Evidence and limits

- [ ] No personal data, secrets, home addresses or unpublished/sensitive sites
- [ ] New data (if any) has official source link, agency, reuse terms, timestamp and NYC coverage
- [ ] No invented opening hours, access eligibility, legal advice or realtime transit information
- [ ] No unexpected tracking, account requirement, payment or new external runtime service
- [ ] Screenshots (if any) are public-safe and show no user location or private content
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and documented any tests I could not perform

## What changed?

Describe exact files, behavior and possible regression risks.

## Maintainer review

All pull requests are **proposals only**. GitHub Pages deploys from protected `main`; approval, merge and deployment decisions belong to the authorized maintainer. No automatic merge is configured.
